primitives.name: Core exercise prescription principles
primitives.verbatim_quote: Of the six core principles of exercise prescription, specificity was the most reported (83.3%), and diminished returns and reversibility were least reported (8.3%), with only two studies reporting on more than two principles in total.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes standard Hoffman (2002) framework: specificity targets specific muscles/benefits, overload increases stress beyond baseline, progression linearly escalates load, initial values define baseline fitness, diminishing returns describe tapering effect of repeated overload, reversibility indicates fitness loss without stimulus.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Principle failure occurs when specificity mismatch causes irrelevant adaptation; reversibility leads to rapid detraining in underserved populations.

layer2.mapping: Bayesian hierarchical model for personalized resistance prescription, where principles inform prior distributions over individual response parameters.
layer2.telemetry: Adherence to principle-specific exercise doses quantifies alignment with target physiological adaptations.

primitives.name: FITT prescription principles
primitives.verbatim_quote: Data relating to principles of exercise prescription (specificity, overload, progression, initial values, diminished returns, reversibility), FITT (frequency, intensity, time, time) principles, and fidelity (adherence, dose, quality of delivery, client responsiveness, differentiation) were extracted and summarised descriptively.
primitives.assumptions: FITT operates as a control-theoretic parameterization: frequency (1/T) sets temporal sampling rate, intensity defines force-velocity trade-off, time denotes duration per session, and time (total) governs overall training period.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Miscalibration of FITT parameters induces suboptimal adaptation; excessive frequency without recovery causes overtraining, insufficient intensity yields minimal gains.

layer2.mapping: Conformal prediction intervals for optimal FITT ranges, accounting for regional/rural covariates affecting individual tolerability.
layer2.telemetry: Actual versus prescribed FITT ratios flag deviations from intended dose-response trajectories.

primitives.name: Fidelity measures in exercise delivery
primitives.verbatim_quote: Differentiation (aspects of the intervention that distinguished it from other interventions and contributed to the success) was the most reported aspect of fidelity (100%), with dose (i.e., adherence to prescribed plan) not reported in any study.
primitives.assumptions: Fidelity hinges on accurate measurement: differentiation captures unique intervention features, adherence tracks actual participation, dose records total administered units, quality assesses delivery standards, and responsiveness reflects participant engagement.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Zero dose reporting creates a blind spot; differentiation alone cannot substitute for direct measurement of delivered versus prescribed volume.

layer2.mapping: State-transition models track fidelity states (e.g., planned vs. executed), with dose serving as the primary latent variable in hidden Markov frameworks.
layer2.telemetry: Deviation of delivered dose from prescribed dose identifies fidelity breaches that compromise efficacy.

reasoning_traces.think:
The three primitives form a unified triptych: principles guide design, FITT operationalizes scheduling, and fidelity verifies execution. In underserved regions, heterogeneity in patient comorbidities and resource scarcity introduces dualities—e.g., specificity must balance generic protocols against costly personalization. Failure modes emerge when principles are ignored (irrelevant gains), FITT is miscalibrated (overtraining/detraining), or fidelity metrics are absent (black-box interventions). State-transition reasoning reveals that dose zero invalidates the entire causal chain from prescription to outcome. Cross-layer veto conditions demand that no single metric dominates; e.g., high differentiation without documented dose remains anecdotal.
